golden_rules.query: Engine oil pressure at 3000 min-1
golden_rules.test_method: Check oil pressure gauge at 3000 rpm
golden_rules.failure_indication: Oil pressure too low indicates lubrication system problem

golden_rules.query: Normal coolant operating temperature range
golden_rules.test_method: Check coolant temperature gauge during operation
golden_rules.failure_indication: Overheating if exceeds maximum limit

golden_rules.query: Coolant high temperature alarm threshold
golden_rules.test_method: Monitor coolant temperature indicator
golden_rules.failure_indication: Engine damage and seizure if operation continues

golden_rules.query: Engine oil capacity at 7° rake angle for 3JH40
golden_rules.test_method: Check oil level with dipstick between upper and lower marks
golden_rules.failure_indication: Insufficient lubrication if below minimum

golden_rules.query: Engine oil capacity at 0° rake angle for 3JH40
golden_rules.test_method: Check oil level with dipstick between upper and lower marks
golden_rules.failure_indication: Insufficient lubrication if below minimum

golden_rules.query: Engine oil capacity at 7° rake angle for 4JH45/4JH57
golden_rules.test_method: Check oil level with dipstick between upper and lower marks
golden_rules.failure_indication: Insufficient lubrication if below minimum

golden_rules.query: Engine oil capacity at 7° rake angle for 4JH80/4JH110
golden_rules.test_method: Check oil level with dipstick between upper and lower marks
golden_rules.failure_indication: Insufficient lubrication if below minimum

golden_rules.query: V-ribbed belt deflection with 100N force
golden_rules.test_method: Push on middle of belt with finger (100N force)
golden_rules.failure_indication: Slipping and coolant pump failure if too loose

golden_rules.query: Maximum starter motor cranking time
golden_rules.test_method: Time the cranking duration
golden_rules.failure_indication: Starter motor overheating if exceeded

golden_rules.query: Minimum waiting time between cranking attempts
golden_rules.test_method: Wait between cranking attempts
golden_rules.failure_indication: Starter motor damage if not allowed to cool

golden_rules.query: All alarm lamps illuminate during power-on self-test
golden_rules.expected_value: All alarm lamps light up for 4 seconds
golden_rules.test_method: Turn on power switch and observe indicators
golden_rules.failure_indication: Warning system malfunction if lamps don't illuminate

golden_rules.query: Seawater discharge from exhaust outlet during operation
golden_rules.test_method: Visual inspection of water flow from exhaust
golden_rules.failure_indication: Seawater pump impeller damage if insufficient discharge

golden_rules.query: Fuel filter/water separator drain frequency when water detected
golden_rules.test_method: Check water separator for water presence
golden_rules.failure_indication: Engine damage if water reaches injection system

golden_rules.query: Battery electrolyte level check for serviceable batteries
golden_rules.expected_value: Level between minimum and maximum marks
golden_rules.test_method: Remove plugs and visually inspect electrolyte level
golden_rules.failure_indication: Battery destruction if operated with insufficient electrolyte

golden_rules.query: Remote control handle in NEUTRAL for engine start
golden_rules.expected_value: Handle must be in NEUTRAL position
golden_rules.test_method: Check remote control handle position before starting
golden_rules.failure_indication: Safety equipment prevents starting in gear position

golden_rules.query: Marine gear shifting at engine speeds below 1000 min-1
golden_rules.expected_value: Shift only at idle speed (below 1000 min-1)
golden_rules.test_method: Check engine speed before engaging clutch
golden_rules.failure_indication: Marine gear damage if shifted at high speed

golden_rules.query: Engine warm-up at low speed after cold start
golden_rules.expected_value: Run at low speed under moderate load until normal temperature
golden_rules.test_method: Monitor coolant temperature gauge during warm-up
golden_rules.failure_indication: Poor combustion and white smoke if loaded when cold

golden_rules.query: Engine idle period before shutdown
golden_rules.expected_value: 5 minutes at low speed without load
golden_rules.test_method: Run engine at approximately 1000 min-1 for 5 minutes
golden_rules.failure_indication: Reduced engine life if hot components not cooled properly

golden_rules.query: Seacock closure after engine shutdown
golden_rules.expected_value: Seacock must be closed after operation
golden_rules.test_method: Manually close seawater intake valve
golden_rules.failure_indication: Boat may sink if water enters through open seacock

golden_rules.query: Racing engine periodically during low speed operation
golden_rules.expected_value: Race engine every 2 hours during prolonged low speed operation
golden_rules.test_method: With gear in NEUTRAL, accelerate from low to high speed 5 times
golden_rules.failure_indication: Carbon buildup and poor performance if neglected

golden_rules.query: Emergency stop switch operation
golden_rules.test_method: Press emergency stop switch
golden_rules.failure_indication: Use only in emergency - causes sudden engine shutdown

golden_rules.query: Oil filter tightening torque after gasket contact
golden_rules.expected_value: Additional 3/4 turn clockwise after gasket contacts housing
golden_rules.test_method: Hand tighten until gasket contacts, then wrench 3/4 turn more
golden_rules.failure_indication: Oil leaks if under-tightened, filter damage if over-tightened

golden_rules.query: Fuel system air bleeding after filter changes
golden_rules.expected_value: Complete air bleeding until no bubbles in fuel flow
golden_rules.test_method: Pump priming pump until steady fuel flow with no air bubbles
golden_rules.failure_indication: Engine won't start if air remains in fuel system

golden_rules.query: Coolant filler cap pressure release before removal
golden_rules.expected_value: Loosen cap to relieve pressure before full removal
golden_rules.test_method: Turn cap slightly counterclockwise to release pressure first
golden_rules.failure_indication: Serious burns from steam and hot coolant if removed when hot

golden_rules.query: Seawater pump impeller replacement interval
golden_rules.expected_value: Replace every 1000 hours even if undamaged
golden_rules.test_method: Check hour meter for 1000-hour intervals
golden_rules.failure_indication: Cooling system failure if impeller fails unexpectedly

golden_rules.query: Engine oil change after initial 50 hours
golden_rules.expected_value: Must change oil and filter after first 50 hours
golden_rules.test_method: Check hour meter for initial 50-hour mark
golden_rules.failure_indication: Accelerated wear if contaminated break-in oil not changed

golden_rules.query: Maximum ambient temperature for operation
golden_rules.test_method: Check ambient air temperature
golden_rules.failure_indication: Engine overheating and oil breakdown if exceeded

golden_rules.query: Minimum ambient temperature for operation
golden_rules.test_method: Check ambient air temperature
golden_rules.failure_indication: Premature wear from hardened seals if operated too cold

golden_rules.query: Wait time before turning off battery switch after power switch off
golden_rules.test_method: Count 6 seconds after turning power switch off
golden_rules.failure_indication: Alarm may be set at next activation if not allowed to settle

golden_rules.query: VC10/VC20/VC30 SEL lamp operation for multi-station
golden_rules.expected_value: SEL lamp flashes for multi-station configuration
golden_rules.test_method: Press power switch and observe SEL lamp behavior
golden_rules.failure_indication: Station selection not available if lamp doesn't flash

golden_rules.query: VC10/VC20/VC30 SEL lamp operation for single station
golden_rules.expected_value: SEL lamp comes on steady for single station
golden_rules.test_method: Press power switch and observe SEL lamp behavior
golden_rules.failure_indication: System not ready if lamp doesn't illuminate

golden_rules.query: KM35P marine gear oil capacity
golden_rules.test_method: Check oil level with dipstick
golden_rules.failure_indication: Gear damage if oil level too low

golden_rules.query: KM4A1 marine gear oil capacity
golden_rules.test_method: Check oil level with dipstick
golden_rules.failure_indication: Gear damage if oil level too low

golden_rules.query: SD60-5 sail drive oil capacity
golden_rules.expected_value: 3.1 L (3.3 qt) standard, 3.3 L (3.4 qt) long reach
golden_rules.test_method: Check oil level with dipstick without screwing in
golden_rules.failure_indication: Drive unit damage if oil level insufficient

golden_rules.query: Fuel cetane number requirement
golden_rules.test_method: Check fuel specification from supplier
golden_rules.failure_indication: Poor combustion and engine damage if cetane too low

golden_rules.query: Sulfur content in fuel requirement
golden_rules.expected_value: Not exceed 0.5% by volume, preferably less than 0.05%
golden_rules.test_method: Check fuel specification from supplier
golden_rules.failure_indication: Engine damage and emissions non-compliance if exceeded

golden_rules.query: Biodiesel fuel blend limit
golden_rules.test_method: Check fuel supplier specifications
golden_rules.failure_indication: Fuel system component damage and warranty void if exceeded

golden_rules.query: LCD brightness adjustment steps
golden_rules.test_method: Press and hold left button, then adjust brightness
golden_rules.failure_indication: Display may be unreadable in certain lighting conditions

golden_rules.query: Trolling handle position for normal operation (KMH4A)
golden_rules.expected_value: Trolling handle must be in high-speed (H) position
golden_rules.test_method: Check trolling handle position before normal operation
golden_rules.failure_indication: Reduced engine speed if left in trolling position

golden_rules.query: Maximum engine operation time at full throttle during break-in
golden_rules.expected_value: Not more than 1 minute at WOT during first 10 hours
golden_rules.test_method: Monitor throttle position and time during break-in period
golden_rules.failure_indication: Engine damage if operated at full throttle too long when new

golden_rules.query: Break-in operation schedule 10-50 hours
golden_rules.expected_value: 70% load most of the time, 80% load 10 min every 30 min, WOT 4-5 min every 30 min
golden_rules.test_method: Monitor engine speed and load during break-in period
golden_rules.failure_indication: Poor ring seating and increased oil consumption if not properly broken in
